page.layout: One page of text, centred; below it a woodcut ornament; a narrow strip of margin notes at the far left edge of the scan (partly cut off, from the facing page).

l.i: Domini & Seruatoris nostri, a quo omnis bona donatio proficis-
citur, cælesti benedictione sua velit efficere, ut T. C. & M. firmis-
simo sit præsidio huic Academiæ, & hæc vicissim tibi ornamento
quàm diutissimè ad gloriam suam & commune bonum patriæ, Ecclesiæ Christianæ, & Reipublicæ. Amen.

page.notes: The left margin strip contains fragments of notes from the facing page, too cut off to transcribe reliably. A woodcut ornament (a mask with scrolls) lies below the text and is not transcribed. The signature line "Seruus studiosissimus / FRANCISCUS IUNIUS." is set in small capitals and italic; its exact layout is approximate.
